python - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError,URLError
urls=[
'https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11860762/bin/mmc4.xlsx',
'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC11860762/bin/mmc4.xlsx',
'https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/11860762/bin/mmc4.xlsx',
'https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/oa_package/62/d1/PMC11860762.tar.gz',
'https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/pmc/oa_package/62/d1/PMC11860762.tar.gz'
]
with open('url_status.txt','w') as out:
  for u in urls:
    try:
      r=urlopen(Request(u,method='HEAD'),timeout=30)
      out.write(f'{r.status}\t{r.headers.get("Content-Length")}\t{u}\n')
    except Exception as e:
      out.write(f'ERROR\t{type(e).__name__}:{e}\t{u}\n')
PY
